## Copilot review -> Claude responder

Starts `.github/workflows/claude-copilot-responder.yml` in `Appmixer-ai/appmixer-connectors` whenever GitHub Copilot submits a review.

**Why this flow exists.** A `pull_request_review` run raised by the Copilot bot on a PR from the apx-vero fork is gated by GitHub (*fork PR workflows from outside collaborators*) and waits on "Approve and run". A `repository_dispatch` run is raised by the token owner, runs on the default branch and is never gated.

**Source of truth:** `.github/appmixer-flows/copilot-review-dispatch.json` and its README in the connectors repo. Edit there, then re-import.

e3000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002.content:
### Trigger: New Review

One event per **review**, not per inline comment — Copilot's single review holds many comments, and the responder works per review.

Author `copilot` is a substring match: the same account is `copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]` here, `Copilot` on review comments. `bots` keeps humans out.

Scans PRs in **any** state, so approve-then-merge is not lost.

e3000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003.content:
### Dispatch: `copilot-review`

Payload `{pr_number, review_id}` — the workflow accepts numeric ids only.

**Account needs push** to the repo (bound: vtalas). apx-vero has only triage.

**403 "OAuth App access restrictions"** = the Appmixer-ai org revoked the grant for the Appmixer GitHub app (client `1c0ed414fe35895cb5ce`). Re-grant, then **re-authorize** the account — that stops this flow, start it again.

Failures land in the dead-letter queue. Retry only while the flow is **running** — a retry into a stopped flow is lost.
